#### 1. Introduction

The Seagate® IronWolf® 525 SSD is built for NAS, and delivers high endurance, performance and caching speeds of up 
to 5000MB/s for NVMe-compatible systems. The Seagate IronWolf 525 SSD offers PCIe Gen 4 x4 interface with NVMe 
protocol support in an ultra-small M.2 form factor..
